messages:
alex: Quick sync: customer Ops wants the rollout to include per-tenant A/B testing gates before switching any traffic. Not just opt-in percentages.
mina: So they want a 1:1 A/B for a subset of requests to detect user-visible regressions earlier? Good idea.
rohit: Implementation note: we can mirror requests and run both variants, but cost doubles for those slices. Need approval from Finance for pilot.
tia: We can optimize by sampling only high-value requests (auth-likely or long prompts). Also require a clear signal to escalate.
sre-bot: alert: canary-run-3 scheduled -> start in 2h -> duration 24h.
alex: Let's not conflate this with the EU opt-in pilot; this is a separate A/B policy framework for sensitive customers. Can we include it as an optional extra in Console?
mina: UI idea: toggles for "enable A/B gate" + sampling rate + customer prompt set.
rohit: Need to define metrics for regression: reranking score change, hallucination flag rate, latency p99 change.
tia: We'll need a short privacy blurb for customers since we may store paired outputs for evaluation.
alex: OK. Owners: Mina (UI), Rohit (sampling infra + cost estimate), Tia (privacy + consent), Alex (product + pilot signups).
mina: timeline: prototype UI by next Tue.
rohit: I'll model cost for a 5% A/B sampling on 3 pilot tenants.
alex: Cool. No blockers.
